Thorough knowledge and experience with engineering principles and methods to independently perform the full range of engineering professional design work.
Knowledge and experience in the design, development and fabrication of scientific apparatus and general fixtures.
Experience in managing experimental test laboratories and supervision of laboratory personnel. Ordering supplies, purchasing equipment, and communicating with vendors.
Experience in facilities construction and laboratory design.
Effective experience and current knowledge of MS Operating Systems and basic computer networks knowledge

Extensive experience and knowledge of procedures for the safe handling, storage, and waste management of chemicals as applicable to Federal and State EHS requirements, as well as applicable to UC Irvine EH&S policies.
Experience working with apparatuses or devices in areas such as biomechanics, bioinstrumentation, biosensing, tissue engineering or imaging systems.
Hands-on experience working with electronics and instrumentation
3-5 years Instructional lab management experience in higher educational environment

Under the general supervision and direction of the Chair and Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) in the Department of Biomedical Engineering (BME) in the Samueli School of Engineering, applies expertise as a seasoned engineering professional to manage and oversee the operations, maintenance, and safety of BME research laboratories and departmental teaching facilities in support of the department's research and instructional mission.

Assignments typically require concentration in a field of application where subject matter knowledge relevant to research objectives and methodology is of great value in understanding and establishing engineering design criteria. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Assists with research planning, analysis, and interpretation of data; designs, develops, and implements lab capabilities, prototypes, and specialized equipment. Serves as consultant on design and development issues; assists and advises undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and visiting scholars towards safe and appropriate operation of all laboratory equipment and facilities; provides technical consultation for the procurement of research equipment. Trains users (including Teaching Assistants - TA’s responsible for laboratory classes) on department instructional lab equipment. Serves as the Department Safety Coordinator Safety Officer.

Engages with students; advises, guides and proactively assists students with hands-on operation of classroom lab experiments and extracurricular projects (including, but not limited to Senior Design). Designs and provides specifications for lab specimens. Directs all participants towards maintaining neat and well-organized laboratory spaces. Determines requirements and maintains adequate instructional lab supplies and consumables.
General and instructional laboratory management, safety oversight, and technical support.

Engineering information, advice, and safety details to Principal Investigators and / or other faculty and research personnel with administrative responsibility for the research program or teaching facilities.

Instruction – for faculty, TAs, and students - on the safe and appropriate use of various types of laboratory equipment, specialized devices, and shared departmental resources. Trains and co-supervises Teaching Assistants in the operation of department instructional laboratory equipment, experimental processes, and apparatus operation and general teaching responsibilities as needed.
Consultation and engineering services for repairs and/or modifications of existing experimental equipment for the BME classroom laboratory.
Information regarding operating principles and operational methods and actively participates in all classroom lab sessions.
In collaboration with the course instructor(s)
Provides professional engineering services in support of all instructional laboratory equipment and facilities in a safe and orderly fashion to ensure safe and reliable operation.
Designs, develops, and assists in the planning and implementation of laboratory apparatus and experimental procedures.
Provides full range of professional engineering services to research projects; meets with research staff in the design and development phase.

Designs, develops, and assists in the planning and implementation of laboratory and experimental equipment and facilities. Analyzes and troubleshoots laboratory problems – informs PIs - and takes action to resolve issues. Acts as the primary point of contact for communicating the technical capabilities of BME laboratories to external stakeholders, including local industry partners, and responds to related inquiries in a timely and professional manner. Provides leadership and support for community outreach initiatives and oversees the coordination of laboratory access, equipment provisioning, and facility resources for incoming, outgoing, and visiting faculty and scholars.
Performs design, construction, assembly and testing of complex experimental equipment and instrument systems.

Provides oversight for all research laboratory equipment, instructional laboratory equipment, and departmental facilities in a safe and orderly fashion to ensure safe and reliable operation. Provides subject matter expertise towards repairs, calibration, and testing of research equipment as feasible. Selects provider or vendor and schedules / oversees all outside entities for repair, calibration, and/or professional certification of equipment. Selects fabricator and manages outsourced fabrication as applicable. Performs / manages any necessary repairs / modifications to laboratory facilities as identified by routine EH&S laboratory inspections. Serves as technical buyer of the department.
Determines project specifications and parameters.

Analyzes needs and requirements for fabrication of specialized laboratory equipment. Advises on the identification, design, and implementation of the necessary infrastructure. Manages and administers laboratory and facilities usage as requested from other departments.

Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes annual and semi-annual reports including inventory reports. Gathers data and maintains the University’s Property Inventory System for all BME laboratory equipment. Performs annual inventory inspections.

Serves as the Department Safety Coordinator in collaboration with the School of Engineering Dean's Office to oversee activities such as the development of Standard Operating Procedures Plans for laboratories - ensuring full compliance of the laboratory safety program. Enforces all safety measures in all laboratory areas. Provides and manages the infrastructure necessary to produce efficient and safe performance during all laboratory activities. Arranges for the proper accumulation, labeling, and disposal of hazardous waste from laboratory areas.

In conjunction with the School of Engineering Facilities Director or Facilities Management staff, coordinates arrangements for renovation and construction activities for laboratories and department / faculty office spaces, as well as the coordination of new furniture / fixtures and/or equipment installations.

Implements related business processes as needed. Develops and implements safety standards for all lab operations. Analyzes, designs, and suggests equipment modifications and/or procedural changes in the operation of instructional lab experiments to simplify operation and improve results.

Demonstrated organizational and decision-making abilities to prioritize competing work assignments in order to meet deadlines and adherence to quality standards, and to meet the needs of faculty, researchers, and students.
Possession of a positive, “can do” attitude. Strong sense of responsibility, excellent work ethic, and commitment to producing quality work
Detail-oriented, which is essential to make sure the lab is ready for all users
Thorough knowledge necessary to apply principles, practices and procedures in the completion of assignments.

Knowledge and skill in precision fabrication, calibration, and maintenance, including the ability to design, fabricate, install, and test experimental devices and instrumentation for biomedical engineering research and educational projects, utilizing equipment such as drill presses, circular saws, sanders, and other machine shop tools.
Strong analytical and judgment skills to independently conduct analyses and develop appropriate recommendations.
Basic coding skills
Effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills to communicate effectively and professionally with students, staff, and faculty
Fundamental knowledge of Biomedical Engineering principles, instrumentation and laboratory processes.
Ability to work in a collaborative manner; identify challenges and barriers and recommend resolutions.
Highly developed analytical skills to solve problems in varied situations.
Ability to lead and influence others.

Ability to maintain and repair laboratory equipment and provide preventative maintenance on biomedical engineering equipment including microscopes, lasers, optical systems, cameras, and a wide range of electrical and signal processing instruments, including function generators, electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG) equipment, spectrophotometers, and fluorometers.
Ability to complete projects and tasks independently and in a timely manner.
Interpersonal skills to interact effectively with students, staff and faculty to provide instruction in the operation of equipment used in conducting experiments.
Ability to maintain an atmosphere that fosters teamwork and collegial collaboration with all levels of users and diverse groups of people.
Ability and flexibility to respond to changing priorities in a customer service environment. Excellent customer service skills.
Ability to provide guidance and explanations to graduate and undergraduate students in laboratory procedures and safe / appropriate operation of lab equipment.
Skill and ability to keep current, learn and implement latest instructional techniques, processes, lab equipment and general lab best practices.
Posses strong organizational skills
Skills, knowledge and ability to effectively develop, establish, teach and enforce laboratory safety procedures for students, faculty and guests.
Knowledge of instrumentation necessary to build experimental apparatus.
